name: Save the Children (UK)
summary: A children's charity founded in London in 1919 and one of about 30 members of the Save the Children movement. Save the Children UK raises money in Britain (from the UK government, the Global Partnership for Education, Gavi, the Disasters Emergency Committee and the public) and passes most of it to Save the Children International, which runs the country programmes: schooling in crises, immunisation and child health, malnutrition treatment, livelihoods, child protection and emergency response, plus advocacy in the UK and abroad. Modelled on Save the Children UK's audited 2025 accounts (Save the Children US's are behind a bot check).
